title: Generative Support Realignment for Cross-Domain Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.13054v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cross-domain offline reinforcement learning learns a target policy from pre-collected source and target datasets with different dynamics. When target data are scarce, effectively compensating for their limited coverage using source data remains challenging due to the discrepancy between domains. We propose Target-aligned Coverage Expansion (TCE), which leverages source states to generatively realign and expand the limited target support while controlling the generation error induced by this expansion. We further derive a performance gap bound that characterizes the interplay between generation error and source--target dynamics gap, providing theoretical guidance for effective coverage expansion and source utilization. Across diverse cross-domain environments, TCE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, while further analysis empirically supports the guidance provided by our theoretical findings.

translated_title: 面向跨域离线强化学习的生成式支持域重对齐
translated_abstract: 跨域离线强化学习旨在从预先收集的、具有不同动态特性的源数据集和目标数据集中学习目标策略。当目标数据稀缺时，由于领域之间的差异，如何有效利用源数据来弥补目标数据有限的覆盖范围仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了目标对齐覆盖扩展方法，该方法利用源状态以生成的方式重新对齐并扩展有限的目标支持域，同时控制这种扩展所引入的生成误差。我们进一步推导出一个性能差距界，刻画了生成误差与源-目标动态差距之间的相互作用，为有效的覆盖扩展和源数据利用提供了理论指导。在多样化的跨域环境中，TCE始终优于最先进的基线方法，同时进一步的分析从实证角度支持了我们理论发现所提供的指导。
tldr: 提出目标对齐覆盖扩展（TCE）方法，利用源状态生成式地重对齐并扩展目标数据支持域，并推导出刻画生成误差与源-目标动态差距相互作用的性能差距界，在跨域离线强化学习中一致优于现有最先进方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes Target-aligned Coverage Expansion (TCE), which generatively realigns and expands the limited target support using source states, and derives a performance gap bound characterizing the interplay between generation error and source-target dynamics gap, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in cross-domain offline reinforcement learning.
